summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 (E2E Test Expansion & Staging Baselines) — create shared account cleanup helpers, media/streaming E2E suites, batch download tests, and capture staging performance baselines including BYO-IPFS load tests.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans completed and verified (13/13 must-haves passed). PR #392 created and all 15 reviewer threads resolved. Real 200-client sustained load baselines captured (0.17% error rate, 11,174 ops). BYO capacity ceiling captured but Pinata free tier exhausted before meaningful pin data collected.

repo: Staging uses Web3Auth which takes ~22.7s to initialize — wallet button timeout of 20s in journey-timing.spec.ts was too short for staging environments
playwright.config.ts BASE_URL env var was not wired to override the Playwright baseURL config, and the webServer block needed a conditional skip when targeting staging
The SDK load test harness (tests/load/) uses direct API calls with bypass headers; the browser load test (tests/web-e2e/tests/load-test.spec.ts) was redundant and has been removed
Running two load test processes simultaneously against staging saturated the API — the throttle bypass header works correctly when only one test suite runs at a time
Vitest does not auto-load .env files; env vars must be sourced via shell before running vitest (source .env && pnpm vitest)
The BYO-IPFS register-cid and ipns-publish endpoints return 400 on staging — Pinata pin succeeds but CipherBox API rejects CID registration (test accounts may not be provisioned for BYO mode)
cleanup-helpers.ts derives the API URL from the page URL (app subdomain → api subdomain replacement) since VITE_API_URL is not accessible at test runtime on staging
deleteAccountViaPage uses page.evaluate to call fetch with cookies — only valid for browser-based Playwright tests, not SDK headless tests which use destroyClientPool() → deleteTestAccount()

code.finding: waitFor timeout for wallet-login-button was 20000ms — increased to 60000ms for staging where Web3Auth init takes ~22.7s
Added BASE_URL env var support and conditional webServer skip when targeting non-localhost environments
API URL derived from page URL at runtime; two page.evaluate calls merged into one to eliminate extra browser round-trip
No dotenv loading — env must be sourced via shell before running tests
createTestMediaFile needs path.basename() sanitization on filename parameter to prevent path traversal

BYO env vars scoped to byo-* scenario conditional with explicit error if LOAD_TEST_BYO_AUTH_TOKEN secret is missing; endpoint/protocol/label exposed as workflow_dispatch inputs with defaults for per-run provider switching

workflow: Cherry-picking commits from worktree branches to the phase branch requires careful STATE.md conflict resolution — worktree version should win since it has the latest plan state
Running parallel load test suites against the same staging instance causes apparent throttle bypass failures — always run load tests sequentially against shared staging
CodeRabbit and Copilot re-review after fixes can introduce new threads — should run /resolve-pr-comments in a loop until zero unresolved threads
GSD phase completion should not be marked until all baselines are meaningful — premature phase completion required rollback when load test data was invalidated
BYO capacity ceiling test consumed the entire Pinata free tier quota across multiple failed runs before cleanup — need paid Pinata account for meaningful BYO baseline data

friction: Web3Auth 22.7s init time on staging caused journey-timing test to fail with 20s timeout — required code change to unblock baseline capture
BASE_URL env var not wired in playwright.config.ts — tests silently hit localhost instead of staging URL, requiring config investigation

Running sustained-load (200 clients) and BYO ceiling tests simultaneously saturated staging, producing false 429 throttle bypass failures — took significant debugging to identify concurrent execution as root cause
Vitest does not load .env files automatically — BYO tests skipped silently until shell env sourcing was added
Git worktree cherry-pick conflicts on STATE.md required manual resolution across 4 separate plan merges
Git lock files from failed/killed worktree agents required force cleanup before retry
Pinata free tier was exhausted by multiple failed BYO ceiling test runs, invalidating all BYO pin baseline data
SSH to staging VPS failed (timeout/key issue) during throttle bypass investigation — had to fall back to curl-based diagnostics
Phase completion was prematurely committed before load tests produced meaningful data, requiring manual rollback discussion

Pinata paid plan needed to capture real BYO capacity ceiling baselines — free tier exhausted during Phase 34
